reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 7, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: The number 573 is written in words as 'five hundred sixty-three'. True or False?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every one of the 7 samples tests the numeral-words correspondence the competency names; seed 50's true/false check 'The number 573 is written in words as five hundred sixty-three' (correctly false, since 573 is five hundred seventy-three) exercises reading/verification alongside the writing tasks.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Numeral-to-words translation is well covered by all 7 varied-format seeds, but the reverse direction (given words, produce or select the numeral) never appears anywhere in this widened sample, even though the competency names both directions symmetrically.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems stay short (4-6 words, e.g. seed 72's 'Write 139 in words.') and vocabulary-light across all three formatters (mcq, true_false, cloze), appropriate for grade 3 quarter 1.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The widened packet shows genuine format diversity: mcq selection (42-46), true/false verification (50), and cloze fill-in (72), giving the pupil multiple interaction modes for the same underlying numeral-words skill.

competency_alignment.rationale: The numeral-words correspondence task matches this competency precisely across all 7 seeds and correctly avoids drifting into the place-value or pictorial-model territory that belongs to sibling lc mat_g3_na_q1_0.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Across all 7 seeds, including the two extra seeds chosen specifically to surface different rendering paths (true_false at 50, cloze at 72), the largest value that ever appears is 573; the competency's ceiling is 10 000 and no 4-digit numeral is ever produced.
